title: A Warrior’s Loyalty
description: A training-ground conversation about honour, respect, recruitment and fear. The same entrance yields different branches depending on directed status, Fear, Trust, and Respect.
note: This is authored sample content; it does not trigger a duel or memory event. The Studio and runtime use the latest relationship/status systems from Phases 9–12.

nodes.title: The edge of a conversation
nodes.host_introduction: Nobunogi runs a cloth along her blade without looking up. "If you came to watch, find a better seat. If you came to speak, speak."

options.label: Ask about her training
options.player_line: You have been at this since dawn.
options.host_success_line: "And I shall still be at it when you are asleep."
options.host_failure_line: "And I shall still be at it when you are asleep."

options.label: Ask her to stand with you
options.player_line: I could use a warrior of your ability beside me.
options.host_success_line: "Then tell me why I should lend you my blade."
options.host_failure_line: "You ask as though I were waiting for an invitation."

options.label: Discuss your alliance
options.player_line: There is something we should discuss as allies.
options.host_success_line: "We are allies. That buys you my attention, not my agreement."
options.host_failure_line: "We are allies. That buys you my attention, not my agreement."

options.label: Offer to settle the hostility
options.player_line: I did not come to reopen our quarrel.
options.host_success_line: "Then be careful which wound you touch."
options.host_failure_line: "Then be careful which wound you touch."

options.label: Ask why she hesitates around you
options.player_line: You watch your words around me. Why?
options.host_success_line: "You notice more than I thought."
options.host_failure_line: "You notice more than I thought."

options.label: Ask her what she really thinks of you
options.player_line: I would hear your judgement, without flattery.
options.host_success_line: "You have earned something better than flattery."
options.host_failure_line: "You have earned something better than flattery."

options.label: Leave her to her training
options.player_line: I will not interrupt you.
options.host_success_line: "Good."
options.host_failure_line: "Good."

nodes.title: The measure of strength
nodes.host_introduction: She tests the edge with her thumb. "Some people sharpen steel. Others sharpen excuses."

options.label: Praise her discipline
options.player_line: Few would train this long without an audience.
options.host_success_line: "An audience is for performers. But you have noticed the work."
options.host_failure_line: "That sounded perilously close to flattery."

options.label: Question whether training is enough
options.player_line: Training means little until someone tests it.
options.host_success_line: "At last, a sensible question. What would you test?"
options.host_failure_line: "You mistake noise for a challenge."

options.label: Ask what she is preparing for
options.player_line: Who are you preparing to face?
options.host_success_line: "Whoever proves stronger than the last. There must always be someone."
options.host_failure_line: "Whoever proves stronger than the last. There must always be someone."

options.label: Change the subject
options.player_line: I had something else to ask.
options.host_success_line: "Then ask it."
options.host_failure_line: "Then ask it."

nodes.title: The price of an alliance
nodes.host_introduction: Nobunogi sheaths the blade. "I will not follow a name, a banner, or a frightened promise. Give me a reason."

options.label: Say you intend to confront Mizuri
options.player_line: Mizuri stands above every other warrior. I intend to face her.
options.host_success_line: "Then our roads may run together. Do not expect me to kneel along the way."
options.host_failure_line: "You speak of the summit. I do not yet believe you can climb."

options.label: Offer an alliance of equals
options.player_line: No obedience. We choose the same fight, and each keeps their honour.
options.host_success_line: "An equal pact, then. Break it and you answer to me."
options.host_failure_line: "Equality is easily promised when nothing has been risked."

options.label: Demand her loyalty through fear
options.player_line: You know what I can do. Do not make me prove it.
options.host_success_line: "I will come. Remember that fear is not fealty."
options.host_failure_line: "A threat is not a victory. You have made an enemy."

options.label: Let the question rest
options.player_line: You need not answer now.
options.host_success_line: "Good. Better a question left standing than a promise that falls."
options.host_failure_line: "Good. Better a question left standing than a promise that falls."

nodes.title: A badly chosen word
nodes.host_introduction: Her expression closes. "If that was your best argument, keep the second one to yourself."

options.label: Admit you misjudged her
options.player_line: I spoke poorly. That was not what I meant.
options.host_success_line: "Then say what you mean, and I may listen."
options.host_failure_line: "You are more interested in escaping blame than speaking plainly."

options.label: Press her harder
options.player_line: You heard me. I will not beg you to understand.
options.host_success_line: "A stubborn answer. I almost respect it."
options.host_failure_line: "You mistake stubbornness for courage."

options.label: End the conversation
options.player_line: We have nothing more to say today.
options.host_success_line: "Then we agree on something."
options.host_failure_line: "Then we agree on something."

nodes.title: A moment without posturing
nodes.host_introduction: For a moment, she looks past you towards the open ground. "Most people ask me who I have beaten. Few ask who I want to fight."

options.label: Ask what she knows about Mizuri
options.player_line: Have you ever seen Mizuri fight?
options.host_success_line: "No. But I have heard enough to know rumours are not victories. Listen."
options.host_failure_line: "And I have heard enough people talk as though they have seen the impossible."

options.label: Say what you are fighting for
options.player_line: I do not want to win merely to be called strongest.
options.host_success_line: "Then decide what you do want before the fight begins."
options.host_failure_line: "Then decide what you do want before the fight begins."

options.label: Leave on better terms
options.player_line: I will think on what you said.
options.host_success_line: "Thinking is useful. Eventually you must act."
options.host_failure_line: "Thinking is useful. Eventually you must act."

nodes.title: A test without drawing steel
nodes.host_introduction: She steps close enough to study your stance. "Everyone claims to want a worthy opponent. Few recognise one."

options.label: Point out a weakness in her stance
options.player_line: You favour your forward foot. A feint could draw you out.
options.host_success_line: "You have eyes after all. I corrected that habit this morning."
options.host_failure_line: "You saw something. You did not understand it."

options.label: Claim you could defeat her
options.player_line: Give me one exchange and I will show you the difference.
options.host_success_line: "Perhaps you will. That is why I am listening."
options.host_failure_line: "Your mouth is faster than your feet."

options.label: Refuse to turn talk into a contest
options.player_line: We need not make every conversation a contest.
options.host_success_line: "No. Only the ones that matter."
options.host_failure_line: "No. Only the ones that matter."

nodes.title: What allies owe one another
nodes.host_introduction: She folds her arms. "If you are about to order me somewhere, choose your words carefully."

options.label: Ask her to plan the fight with you
options.player_line: I want your judgement, not your obedience. How should we approach Mizuri?
options.host_success_line: "Then you shall have it. First, abandon the idea of a glorious charge."
options.host_failure_line: "You need an answer. I need more than a question."

options.label: Ask her to take a risk for you
options.player_line: When the time comes, will you stand in the more dangerous position?
options.host_success_line: "If it is the right position. Not simply because you asked."
options.host_failure_line: "You have confused an ally with a shield."

options.label: Ask for her private assessment
options.player_line: What do you think of the way I lead?
options.host_success_line: "I have an answer. Whether you like it is another matter."
options.host_failure_line: "I have an answer. Whether you like it is another matter."

options.label: Ask why she flinches at your orders
options.player_line: You obey, but you go quiet when I speak.
options.host_success_line: "Some things are easier to say when one is not afraid."
options.host_failure_line: "Some things are easier to say when one is not afraid."

options.label: Leave the matter for now
options.player_line: We will speak of this again.
options.host_success_line: "See that we do."
options.host_failure_line: "See that we do."

nodes.title: A frightened ally
nodes.host_introduction: Nobunogi does not step back, but her grip tightens around the scabbard. "I can follow you. That is not the same as being at ease beside you."

options.label: Promise she will not be punished for honesty
options.player_line: Say what you truly think. You have my word there will be no punishment.
options.host_success_line: "Then hear this: I will fight beside you, but I will not become your shadow."
options.host_failure_line: "Words cost you nothing. I have learned to count deeds instead."

options.label: Tell her that obedience is enough
options.player_line: You need not like me. You need only obey.
options.host_success_line: "As you wish. But do not mistake silence for peace."
options.host_failure_line: "Then you have made it impossible for us to stand together."

options.label: Let the subject drop
options.player_line: You have said enough.
options.host_success_line: "I hope so."
options.host_failure_line: "I hope so."

nodes.title: An enemy at arm’s length
nodes.host_introduction: Her hand is near the hilt. "You have my attention. Do not waste it trying to pretend we are friends."

options.label: Admit you were wrong
options.player_line: I gave you reason to despise me. I know that.
options.host_success_line: "Then let us try beginning with honesty, not friendship."
options.host_failure_line: "A confession means little when you still expect a reward."

options.label: Suggest proving your intentions through action
options.player_line: Judge me by what I do next, not what I say now.
options.host_success_line: "Then show me something worthy of judging."
options.host_failure_line: "I already have. I was not impressed."

options.label: Back away
options.player_line: Not today, then.
options.host_success_line: "Not today."
options.host_failure_line: "Not today."

nodes.title: Words earned, not given
nodes.host_introduction: For once, Nobunogi smiles without mockery. "You have fought hard enough to deserve the truth. Do not ask me to soften it."

options.label: Ask whether she would follow you into danger
options.player_line: If my judgement fails, will you still stand beside me?
options.host_success_line: "I will challenge you first. Then, if you listen, I will stand beside you."
options.host_failure_line: "Do not ask me to excuse a foolish command."

options.label: Invite her to dispute your battle plan
options.player_line: Tell me where I am wrong before we march.
options.host_success_line: "Good. The first mistake is believing the strongest enemy will oblige your plan."
options.host_failure_line: "You wanted argument, but you were not ready to hear it."

options.label: Thank her for speaking plainly
options.player_line: That is more useful than praise. Thank you.
options.host_success_line: "Then make use of it."
options.host_failure_line: "Then make use of it."

nodes.title: An unfinished account
nodes.host_introduction: She turns back to her training. "Whatever we are today, we will learn what that means when steel is drawn."

options.label: Take your leave
options.player_line: Until then.
options.host_success_line: "Until then."
options.host_failure_line: "Until then."

nodes.title: The oath that is not submission
nodes.host_introduction: She offers her forearm, not a bowed head. "Very well. I will fight beside you. I will not fight beneath you."

options.label: Accept her terms
options.player_line: That is precisely what I asked.
options.host_success_line: "Then do not forget it."
options.host_failure_line: "Then do not forget it."

options.label: Ask about Mizuri
options.player_line: Then tell me what you know of Mizuri.
options.host_success_line: "I can tell you what I have heard. Whether it is true is another question."
options.host_failure_line: "I can tell you what I have heard. Whether it is true is another question."

options.label: Leave with your agreement
options.player_line: Then we have an agreement.
options.host_success_line: "We have a beginning."
options.host_failure_line: "We have a beginning."

nodes.title: An ally made by force
nodes.host_introduction: She nods once, with the stiff precision of someone counting the exits. "Call me your ally if it pleases you."

options.label: Demand her opinion
options.player_line: Then speak. What do you think?
options.host_success_line: "I think the best place for a warrior is somewhere she may choose to stand."
options.host_failure_line: "I think the best place for a warrior is somewhere she may choose to stand."

options.label: End the exchange
options.player_line: You have made your decision.
options.host_success_line: "Have I?"
options.host_failure_line: "Have I?"

nodes.title: The line you crossed
nodes.host_introduction: Nobunogi steps back and finally draws an inch of steel. "There. Now we understand each other."

options.label: Withdraw the threat
options.player_line: I went too far. Put the blade away.
options.host_success_line: "You have one chance to show that you meant it."
options.host_failure_line: "Do not mistake my restraint for forgiveness."

options.label: Leave before it escalates
options.player_line: Then this is where we stop.
options.host_success_line: "Wise, for once."
options.host_failure_line: "Wise, for once."

nodes.title: What she knows of Mizuri
nodes.host_introduction: She lowers her voice. "They say Mizuri has never needed to prove herself twice to the same challenger. I cannot tell you if that is true. I intend to find out."

options.label: Ask her to continue
options.player_line: What would you do if she were stronger than you?
options.host_success_line: "Learn why. Then see whether that reason can be broken."
options.host_failure_line: "If you want certainty, ask a fortune teller."

options.label: Say Mizuri will be easy to defeat
options.player_line: Then she will be disappointed when I meet her.
options.host_success_line: "Confidence is a weapon. Keep its edge sharp."
options.host_failure_line: "That is not confidence. It is carelessness."

options.label: Promise you will not underestimate her
options.player_line: I will take her strength seriously. And yours.
options.host_success_line: "Then perhaps we both live long enough to test her."
options.host_failure_line: "Then perhaps we both live long enough to test her."

options.label: Thank her and go
options.player_line: That is enough to think about.
options.host_success_line: "Then think quickly."
options.host_failure_line: "Then think quickly."
